ApiVersionParameter.name: api-version
ApiVersionParameter.description: The API version to use for this operation.

ArmStorageContainerId.description: ARM resource ID for an Azure Storage blob container.

ArmUserAssignedIdentityId.description: ARM resource ID for an Azure user-assigned managed identity.

AsyncOperationStatus.description:
Status of an asynchronous operation.
IMPORTANT: Always use explicit integer values. Never reorder or reassign existing values.

AzureBlobByoVolumeAuth.description:
Authentication for a bring-your-own (BYO) Azure Blob container volume:
how ADC obtains credentials to access the customer-owned container.

AzureBlobByoVolumeAuthAzureBlobByoIdenti.description:
Managed-identity authentication for a BYO blob volume. ADC accesses the
container with a managed identity already on the sandbox group.

BlobUri.description: A strongly-typed blob URI (with or without SAS token).

ConnectionId.description:
Strongly-typed connection identifier.
ConnectionId is intentionally string-based rather than Guid-based because existing
Cosmos DB documents contain connection IDs in mixed formats — some with hyphens
(Guid "D" format: a1b2c3d4-e5f6-...) and some without (Guid "N" format:
a1b2c3d4e5f6...). Converting to a Guid-backed typed ID would normalize all
lookups to the "D" format via Guid.ToString(), breaking reads/deletes of
documents stored with the "N" format since Cosmos DB performs exact string matching
on document IDs.

ConnectionState.description: Represents the state of a connection.

ContainerProbe.description: Probe configuration for checking a container's startup, liveness, or readiness state.

ContainerProbeStatusView.description: Runtime status for a configured container probe.

ContainerResourcesView.description:
Per-container resource configuration.
CPU and Memory set cgroup limits inside the VM. Disk controls writable layer sizing.

ContainerSecurityContext.description:
Container-level security context — overrides pod-level settings where applicable.
Follows Kubernetes container securityContext semantics.

ContainerSpecView.description: Per-container specification within a pod source.

ContainerStatusView.description: Runtime status for one pod container.

ContainerVolumeMountView.description: Per-container volume mount specifying which volume to mount and where.

ContainerVolumeMountsView.description: Per-container grouping of volume mounts for the add operation.

ContentPackageAction.description: Specifies how a content package should be delivered to the container.

CpuStatsView.description: CPU usage counters and load averages.

traceId.description: The OTEL trace ID for correlating logs and requests across services.

traces.description:
Performance spans for waterfall visualization.
Flat list with parent-child relationships via ParentId.

DebugInfo.description: Debug information that can be included in API responses.

mountPoint.description: Mount path (e.g., "/containers/container-0/bundle/rootfs"). Deprecated: use Label instead.

label.description: Human-friendly display label (e.g., "container-0"). If set, UI should prefer this over MountPoint.

DiskStatsEntryView.description: Filesystem usage for a single mount point.

connectionName.description: Connection display name if this is an API Hub connector call.

matchedRule.description: Name of the egress policy rule that matched this request.

EgressForwardMode.description:
Per-rule override of upstream forward-proxy behavior. When a rule matches, the egress proxy either
egresses direct, relays through the rule's EgressForwardProxy? EgressPolicyRuleAction.ForwardProxy, or
inherits the sandbox-level `DefaultForward`.

EgressForwardProxy.description:
Upstream forward-proxy target: the proxy URL plus an optional inline PEM CA bundle that is trusted
(additively, on top of the system roots) when the proxy exposes an https listener. Shared by the
sandbox-level default forward and per-rule EgressForwardProxy? EgressPolicyRuleAction.ForwardProxy. The CA
is a public certificate, not secret. `Url` accepts http/https or a bare host:port (defaults to
http, i.e. no TLS to the proxy).

EgressPolicyActionType.description: Types of actions that an egress policy rule can take.

EgressPolicyHeaderTransform.description: Describes a header transformation to apply to matching requests.

EgressPolicyHookFailBehavior.description:
What the egress proxy should do when a webhook invocation fails (timeout, non-2xx,
invalid payload, SSRF-rejected URL, etc.).

EgressPolicyHookRef.description:
Configures a webhook called at request time for rules whose static decision
cannot be expressed declaratively. When a rule's EgressPolicyHookRef? EgressPolicyRule.HookRef
is set, the egress proxy POSTs a request-context payload to string EgressPolicyHookRef.Endpoint and
applies the returned decision (Allow / Deny / Transform / Rewrite) in place of the
rule's static Action.

EgressRuleRoutingMode EgressPolicyHookRef.RoutingMode controls how the egress proxy reaches the webhook
endpoint itself: EgressRuleRoutingMode.Vnet binds the outbound
socket to the sandbox's customer VNET IP (so the hook host can be a private
service reachable only from inside the VNET), EgressRuleRoutingMode.Platform
forces the node's platform egress (bypassing Swift SNAT), and
EgressRuleRoutingMode.Default uses the sandbox-level routing.
The webhook response itself can also carry a `routingMode` field that
overrides routing for the downstream upstream call when the decision is Rewrite.

EgressPolicyManagedIdentityRef.description:
References a managed identity token to be fetched and injected as a header value.
EgressPolicyManagedIdentityType? EgressPolicyManagedIdentityRef.Type must be set to specify which identity to use.

EgressPolicyRule.description:
A single egress policy rule. Rules are evaluated in order; first match wins.
A rule has either a static EgressPolicyRuleAction? EgressPolicyRule.Action or a dynamic EgressPolicyHookRef? EgressPolicyRule.HookRef, never both.
When EgressPolicyHookRef? EgressPolicyRule.HookRef is set, the proxy calls the configured webhook at request time
and applies the returned decision in place of EgressPolicyRuleAction? EgressPolicyRule.Action.

EgressPolicyRuleAction.description:
The action to take when a rule matches.
For Rewrite actions, Scheme/Host/Path specify the destination to rewrite the request to,
and EgressRuleRoutingMode EgressPolicyRuleAction.RoutingMode optionally overrides the sandbox-level egress routing for
this rule.

EgressPolicyRuleMatch.description:
Request matching criteria for an egress policy rule.
All specified conditions must match (AND logic).
EgressPolicyMatchScheme? EgressPolicyRuleMatch.Scheme is nullable; null means the author did not specify a scheme and the
effective default is resolved per rule polarity at evaluation time. A static Deny defaults to
EgressPolicyMatchScheme.Any so a block is not silently scoped to HTTPS and bypassed
over HTTP. Every other rule — including positive rules (Allow / Transform / Rewrite) and dynamic
EgressPolicyHookRef? EgressPolicyRule.HookRef rules (whose outcome can be Allow/Transform/Rewrite or fail
open) — defaults to EgressPolicyMatchScheme.Https: on plaintext HTTP there is no SNI,
so matching uses the sandbox-controlled Host header with no certificate validation, and a positive
or hook match there would let a sandbox reach a non-allowlisted IP while spoofing an allowlisted
Host. Set EgressPolicyMatchScheme.Any explicitly to match both schemes, or
EgressPolicyMatchScheme.Http / EgressPolicyMatchScheme.Https to pin a
single scheme. For IP-based match hosts, scheme matching is ignored (no TLS certificate validation
applies to IPs anyway).bool? EgressPolicyRuleMatch.NormalizePath controls whether the request path is decoded and normalized
(encoded-slash decode, slash merging, and ./.. dot-segment removal) before it is
matched against string? EgressPolicyRuleMatch.Path. It defaults to enabled (null is treated as true)
to prevent path-confusion bypasses where an encoded path such as /allowed%2F.. matches an
allow rule but the upstream server resolves it to a different path. Set to false only for
upstreams that require the raw, un-normalized path.

EgressPolicySecretRef.description: References a secret stored via the Secrets API for header value injection.

EgressPolicyValueRef.description: A dynamic value reference for header transforms. Exactly one of the ref fields should be set.

EgressRuleRoutingMode.description:
Per-rule override of how the egress proxy creates the upstream socket.
Today only honored on EgressPolicyActionType.Rewrite rules.

GatewayConnectionAuthView.description: Authentication configuration specifying which managed identity to use for a connection at runtime.

Optional user-friendly name for this connection.
Used as the key in mcp-config.json and connections.json.
When not provided, derived from the last segment of string GatewayConnectionView.ResourceId.

mcpRuntimeUrl.description:
MCP server endpoint URL for invoking the connection (agent discovery).
Resolved from the parent sandbox group; not required on sandbox requests.

connectionRuntimeUrl.description:
Direct API Hub connection endpoint URL for app invocation (non-MCP).
Resolved from the parent sandbox group; not required on sandbox requests.

GatewayConnectionView.description:
Represents an AI Gateway connection to associate with a sandbox (3P flow).
On sandbox requests: only string GatewayConnectionView.ResourceId is required; full details are resolved from the parent sandbox group.
On sandbox responses: legacy sandboxes include all fields; new sandboxes include only string GatewayConnectionView.ResourceId.

identity.description:
The identity reference — ARM resource ID for user-assigned, "system" for system-assigned,
or a client ID.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle phase gating for this identity.

IdentitySetting.description:
Per-identity availability setting on a sandbox.
Allows explicit control over which identities from the group are served to the sandbox.

IdentitySettingLifecycle.description: Controls which identity lifecycle phases a specific identity is available in.

IntegerString.description: A signed integer represented as a JSON string.

IpAccessControlRuleView.description: A single IP access control rule.

IpAccessControlView.description:
IP access control configuration for a port.
Rules are evaluated in priority order; first match wins.

LinuxCapabilities.description: Linux capabilities to add or drop from the container's default capability set.

LogColumnDef.description:
Defines a single column in a custom log output schema.
Polymorphic on `kind` discriminator: `"Value"` or `"Ref"`.

LogColumnDefRefLogColumnDef.description: A column whose value is resolved from a well-known ADC attribute at runtime.

value.description: The static value injected into every log record.

LogColumnDefValueLogColumnDef.description: A column whose value is a literal string provided by the partner.

LogColumnRef.description: Well-known ADC attributes that can be referenced by custom columns.

LogFormat.description: Log output format for streaming endpoints.

hookId.description: References string PolicyHookBinding.Id on a tool. Must match a declared hook.

patterns.description:
Glob patterns to match against extracted field values.
For PolicyHookType.FieldValueDenyList: if ANY value matches ANY pattern, the call is blocked.
For PolicyHookType.FieldValueAllowList: if ANY value matches NO pattern, the call is blocked.

McpPolicyRule.description:
A runtime policy rule that activates a declared PolicyHookBinding.
Supplied per-sandbox at creation time (e.g., "block mail to ceo@corp.com").

allowed.description: Last 50 allowed egress requests (most recent first).

denied.description: Last 50 denied egress requests (most recent first).

NumberString.description: A number represented as a JSON string.

startMs.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the span started.

PerfTrace.description: Represents a performance span for waterfall visualization.

PodContentPackageView.description:

PodSecurityContext.description:
Pod-level security context — applies to all containers unless overridden at the container level.
Follows Kubernetes pod securityContext semantics.

PodVolumeView.description:

List of allowed Entra ID object IDs (user or group GUIDs).
Combined with emails, emailSuffixes, and tenantIds, maximum 100 entries allowed.

tenantIds.description:
List of allowed Entra ID tenant IDs (directory GUIDs).
Matches any user from the specified tenant.
Combined with emails, emailSuffixes, and objectIds, maximum 100 entries allowed.

PortAuthConfigEntraId.description: Entra ID-specific auth configuration for a port.

emails.description:
List of allowed email addresses (exact match).
Empty means any @microsoft.com or @github.com user can access.
Combined with emailSuffixes, usernames, and usernameSuffixes, maximum 100 entries allowed.

emailSuffixes.description:
List of allowed email domain suffixes (e.g., "@microsoft.com").
Matches any email ending with the suffix.
Combined with emails, usernames, and usernameSuffixes, maximum 100 entries allowed.

usernames.description:
List of allowed GitHub usernames (exact match).
Empty means any authenticated GitHub user can access.
Combined with emails, emailSuffixes, and usernameSuffixes, maximum 100 entries allowed.

usernameSuffixes.description:
List of allowed username suffixes (e.g., "_microsoft" for EMU accounts).
Matches any username ending with the suffix.
Combined with emails, emailSuffixes, and usernames, maximum 100 entries allowed.

PortAuthConfigGithub.description:
GitHub-specific auth configuration for a port.
Permits users whose verified email ends with @microsoft.com or @github.com.

PortAuthConfigView.description:
Auth configuration for a port.
Each provider can be independently enabled/disabled without removing configuration.

PortCorsConfigView.description: CORS configuration for a sandbox port.

PortProtocol.description: Specifies the HTTP protocol version to use when forwarding requests to a port.

ProbeExecAction.description: Exec probe handler that runs a command in the container.

ProbeHttpGetAction.description: HTTP GET probe handler executed from inside the container VM.

ProbeHttpHeader.description: HTTP header sent with a probe HTTP GET request.

ProbeTcpSocketAction.description: TCP socket probe handler that checks whether a port accepts connections.

tenantId.description: Tenant ID where the agent identity is registered.

agentId.description: Unique identifier for the agent identity.

SandboxAgentIdentityRefView.description: Reference to an agent identity for assigning to a sandbox.

contentPackageId.description: The content package ID to download.

targetPath.description:
The target path in the sandbox where the content package will be downloaded.
Must be an absolute path. Parent directories will be created if they don't exist.

action.description:
How the content package should be delivered: Download (default) or Mount.
Mount presents the package contents as a read-only FUSE filesystem at the target path.
Currently only supported for zip content packages.

SandboxContentPackageDownloadView.description: Represents a content package to be downloaded onto a sandbox during creation.

SandboxGroupCredentialConnectionRefDetai.description: Connector Namespace reference details required by egress HookRef resolution.

SandboxGroupCredentialSource.description: Stored source metadata for a sandbox group credential.

SandboxGroupIdentitySelector.description:
Customer-supplied selector that picks one of the managed identities
already on a sandbox group.

SandboxGroupIdentitySelectorSystemAssign.description: Selects the sandbox group's system-assigned managed identity.

SandboxGroupIdentitySelectorUserAssigned.description: Selects a specific user-assigned managed identity by its ARM resource ID.

SandboxPort.description: Represents a port on an instance (inside the VM).

isWorkIqConnectionEnabled.description:
Whether to enable the WorkIQ (m365-mihshah) connection for the GitHubCopilot preset.
When true, the WorkIQ managed API must be available in the region.

SandboxPresetPropertiesView.description:
Preset-specific properties for sandbox creation.
These properties configure optional features for specific preset types.

isDelegationBackingResource.description: Resolved server-side from the sandbox group. Not part of the wire contract.

auth.description: Group identity selector (ARM id, client id, or system).

name.description:
Disk image name for public disk images (e.g., "nginx", "python3.12").
Mutually exclusive with Id.

isPublic.description:
Indicates whether this references a public disk image.
Must be true when using Name, must be false when using Id.

stoppedAt.description: Wall-clock time the stop transition was recorded.

SandboxStateDetails.description:
Companion document to SandboxState. Populated when a sandbox transitions to
SandboxState.Stopped; null on SandboxState.Running sandboxes
(and on legacy stopped documents written before this field existed).

SeccompProfile.description: Seccomp profile configuration for a container.

SeccompProfileType.description: Seccomp profile type for container syscall filtering.

SecretId.description:
Represents a validated secret identifier.
Must be 3-64 characters, containing only ASCII letters (upper/lower), digits, and hyphens.

connections.description: Last 50 stateful-TCP connection audit entries (most recent first).

StatefulTcpEgressView.description:
Stateful-TCP (TDS) egress connection audit entries. A single recent-connections list carries both
lifecycle phases (Established, Closed); consumers pair them by string? DataPlaneStatefulTcpEntryView.CorrelationId.

timestamp.description: When this phase event was emitted.

proxyLoginName.description:
SQL login used after proxy injection, masked to a prefix before it reaches this
customer-facing view (never the connector's full username).

sourceIp.description: Live client source IP of the sandbox connection.

correlationId.description: Short per-connection correlation id; identical across a connection's two phase entries.

bytesIn.description: Bytes received from the sandbox (final only on the Closed phase).

bytesOut.description: Bytes sent to the backend (final only on the Closed phase).

durationMs.description: Elapsed time from accept to this phase, in milliseconds.

failureReason.description: Optional failure detail when the outcome is not Connected.

startedAt.description: When the connection was accepted (identical across both phases).

StatefulTcpEntryView.description: Single stateful-TCP (TDS) connection audit entry (one lifecycle phase of a connection).

StoppedReason.description:
Reason a sandbox is in SandboxState.Stopped. Carried inside
SandboxStateDetails. Distinguishes operator policy (StoppedReason.Disabled) from
system-driven idle suspends (StoppedReason.Idle) and user-initiated stops
(StoppedReason.UserStopped). Used by the OnDemand auto-resume gate: only StoppedReason.Disabled
blocks auto-resume.

TdsAuthKind.description: Credential kind for a TDS egress connection. Managed identity is deferred (v1).

TdsCredential.description:
A declared TDS credential. string TdsCredential.Name uniquely identifies the credential within its
TdsEgressSection and is what rules (string? TdsEgressAction.Credential) and webhook
responses reference. On the API/contract path EgressPolicySecretRef? TdsCredential.SecretRef is set and string? TdsCredential.Secret is
null. On the runtime path (after Global API resolution) string? TdsCredential.Secret holds the resolved material
and flows (encrypted) to NodeAgent.

TdsEgressAction.description:
Static action for a TDS rule. EgressPolicyActionType TdsEgressAction.Type must be Allow or Deny (Transform/Rewrite are HTTP-only
and rejected by validation). string? TdsEgressAction.Credential names a declared credential and is only valid on Allow.

TdsEgressMatch.description: Match criteria for a TDS egress rule (AND logic). Host is a glob over the SNI / original-dst server.

TdsEgressRule.description:
A single TDS egress rule. Rules are evaluated in order; first match wins. A rule has exactly one of
TdsEgressAction? TdsEgressRule.Action (static) or EgressPolicyHookRef? TdsEgressRule.HookRef (dynamic webhook), never both — same XOR as HTTP.

TdsEgressSection.description:
The TDS section of an egress policy. IReadOnlyList<TdsCredential> TdsEgressSection.Credentials is a list of named credentials (each
string TdsCredential.Name unique within the section), declared once and referenced by name from
static rules and webhook responses. The array-of-named-objects shape matches the rest of the ADC API
(for example Connections); the runtime resolves it into a by-name map. On the runtime path each
credential's string? TdsCredential.Secret is resolved.

TelemetryAuth.description:

Supports user-assigned and system-assigned managed identity; designed for future auth kinds
(e.g., workload identity).

identity.description:
Full ARM resource ID of a user-assigned managed identity
(e.g., /subscriptions/{sub}/resourceGroups/{rg}/providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/{name}).

TelemetryAuthTelemetryManagedIdentityAut.description:
User-assigned managed identity authentication for a Log Analytics telemetry endpoint.
The egress proxy acquires a bearer token via Identity Proxy using the specified user-assigned MI.

TelemetryAuthTelemetrySystemAssignedMana.description:
System-assigned managed identity authentication for a Log Analytics telemetry endpoint.
The egress proxy acquires a bearer token via Identity Proxy using the sandbox group's system-assigned MI.
No explicit identity resource ID is needed — the Identity Proxy defaults to the system-assigned identity.

endpoints.description: One or more telemetry endpoints to route data to.

metricsIntervalSeconds.description: Optional metrics collection interval in seconds. Must be >= 2. Defaults to 15 if not specified.

columns.description:
Optional custom column schema. When set, log records are projected
through this schema before being forwarded. Supported on all endpoint kinds for
`ContainerStdoutStderr` data. Per-kind semantics: OTLP — columns become log record
attributes (the `LogContent` ref also remains the OTLP body), and additionally, for an
OTLP endpoint routing `Metrics`, the `Value` columns and the resource-constant
`Ref` columns (`SandboxId`, `Region`) become OTLP metrics resource attributes
(`ResourceMetrics.Resource.Attributes`); LogAnalytics modern — columns become the DCR
stream record fields; LogAnalyticsLegacy — columns become the HTTP Data Collector API record
fields.

dynamicJsonColumns.description:
When true, JSON log lines are parsed and their top-level
keys are merged into the output record. Reserved keys (`message`, `time`,
`TimeGenerated`, anything starting with `adc.`) and any key already produced by
an explicit LogColumnDef are preserved (the parsed JSON does not override
them). Requires `ContainerStdoutStderr` in IReadOnlyList<TelemetryData> TelemetryEndpoint.Data.

TelemetrySecretReference.description:
Base type for telemetry endpoint secret references. Polymorphic on a `kind`
discriminator that selects between two resolution paths:
* TelemetrySecretRef (kind GlobalSecret) —
references a sandboxGroup-scoped GlobalSecret by id. Used by direct /apps
callers and by legacy payloads that pre-date the artifactApp inline-secrets work.
* TelemetryAppSecretRef (kind AppSecret) —
references a secret by its local name within the app's own
Secrets[] array. Used by Microsoft.App/artifactApps callers
that declare inline secrets on the app resource itself.

TokenUsageStatsView.description: Token usage statistics for a sandbox.

TrafficInspection.description: Controls the scope of TLS inspection for the egress proxy on a per-sandbox basis.

TransportEgressRule.description:
A single L3/L4 transport egress rule. Rules are evaluated in declared order; first match wins.
EgressPolicyActionType TransportEgressRule.Action must be Allow or Deny (Transform/Rewrite are HTTP-only and rejected by validation).
string TransportEgressRule.Destination is an IPv4 CIDR (v1). int? TransportEgressRule.Port is a single destination port
(`1..65535`) or `null` to match every port on the destination (any-port wildcard).

TransportEgressSection.description:
The transport (L3/L4 TCP/UDP) section of an egress policy. Distinct from HTTP and TDS policy and
enforced by NodeAgent at the network layer (`iptables`). EgressPolicyActionType TransportEgressSection.DefaultAction is the terminal
action applied to raw TCP/UDP flows that match no rule; IReadOnlyList<TransportEgressRule> TransportEgressSection.Rules is capped at 10 entries. DNS
(port 53) is always carved out and never constrained by these rules in v1.

TransportProtocol.description: L4 transport protocol for an L3 egress rule.
